context: Introduce one duration normalizer with an explicit millisecond return contract. Prefer explicit millisecond data, convert explicit seconds by 1000, preserve zero, and never infer units from magnitude. Inventory bare execution_time and per_query_timings producers before choosing deprecation or a documented legacy policy. Route all comparison extraction loops through the same boundary and prove canonical file behavior is unchanged.
description: The public in-memory PlatformComparison(results=...) path can treat execution_time_seconds as milliseconds, producing a 1000x error, and truthiness fallbacks discard a legitimate zero-millisecond duration. Canonical v2 file and CLI comparison paths currently reconstruct execution_time_ms and are safe. Fix the public library hazard without changing compact artifact units or regressing file-based comparisons, and settle the dead or ambiguous per_query_timings/execution_time compatibility surface.

anti_patterns.dont: Guess units based on whether a value looks large or small.
anti_patterns.instead: Require a named field or documented legacy contract.

anti_patterns.dont: Preserve dead per_query_timings code without a producer inventory.
anti_patterns.instead: Deprecate it or define and test a real producer contract.
anti_patterns.why: Dead compatibility surfaces create untested ambiguity.

anti_patterns.dont: Use truthiness chains for duration aliases.
anti_patterns.instead: Resolve explicit fields with non-None checks and unit-specific conversion.
anti_patterns.why: They discard zero and obscure unit conversion.

preserves.behavior: Canonical v2 compact artifacts continue storing and loading documented millisecond fields.
No unit is inferred from numerical magnitude.
The benchbox compare CLI produces unchanged values for valid canonical artifacts.
Zero is a valid measured duration and is not treated as missing.

prior_art.concept: Current file and in-memory extraction paths.
Canonical v2 millisecond reconstruction used by file comparisons.

verifications.expected: Direct and file comparison tests pass with correct units.

work_units.evidence: Pinned direct seconds-only 2.0 -> erroneous 2.0 ms reproduction and canonical v2 ms=2000 safe path; regression tests added.
work_units.summary: Pin the direct-constructor 2-second-to-2-millisecond reproduction and the safe canonical-file behavior in tests.

work_units.evidence: Inventory: 33 production files use execution_time_ms, 63 use execution_time_seconds; bare execution_time emitted as seconds by builder; per_query_timings has model declaration/consumers but no producer.
work_units.summary: Inventory all producers and consumers of execution_time_ms, execution_time_seconds, bare execution_time, and per_query_timings.

work_units.evidence: Decision: ms canonical; named seconds and legacy bare execution_time mean seconds; no magnitude inference; per_query_timings retained as compatibility input; conflicts beyond 1 ms fail closed.
work_units.summary: Decide the bare execution_time compatibility policy and whether per_query_timings is deprecated or receives a typed producer contract.

work_units.evidence: Added _normalize_execution_time_ms preserving zero, rejecting booleans/nonnumeric/negative/nonfinite/conflicting values, with 1 ms builder truncation tolerance.
work_units.summary: Implement a single explicit-millisecond normalizer with zero preservation and conflict handling.

work_units.evidence: Both query extraction paths and source collections use one normalizer; true arithmetic mean replaces order-biased pairwise averaging; aggregate total_execution_time uses documented seconds.
work_units.summary: Migrate all comparison query-time extraction paths to the normalizer.

work_units.evidence: Tests cover direct constructor, canonical files, legacy seconds, per_query timings, zero, missing, truncation agreement, conflicts, aggregate cost units, sparse cost platforms, and order independence.
work_units.summary: Add direct-constructor, canonical-file, CLI, zero-duration, and conflicting-unit regression tests.
